niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with clear structure, readable hierarchy, and explicit labeling. They often favor light neutral themes with dark text, soft card styling, subtle elevation, balanced spacing, and restrained accents. They like organized card or list layouts that make actions and status easy to understand through text labels, descriptive metadata, and clear affordances. In some weaker cases they also respond positively to compact, high-contrast dark UIs with strong section separation, but the strongest pattern is toward polished, approachable, information-clear layouts rather than dramatic or decorative ones.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds with dark text or soft gray surfaces, and generally rejects darker high-contrast themes when the preference is strong.
Prefers strong hierarchy with clear section titles, readable contrast, explicit structure, and well-separated content blocks.
Prefers organized card- or list-based layouts with clear grouping, orderly form structure, and distinct sections rather than loose or decorative compositions.
Prefers descriptive text labels, text-labeled actions, numbered badges, drag handles, subtitles, and other explicit cues over icon-only or abbreviated encoding.
Prefers soft outlined or gently elevated cards with subtle borders, shadows, rounded corners, and contained focal elements rather than flat or harshly outlined surfaces.
Prefers balanced, open spacing with neat grouping and calmer visual density, avoiding both cluttered density and oversized decorative emptiness.
Prefers restrained accent colors used purposefully for primary actions or status meaning, rather than intense neon accents or overly dominant decorative color.
